description: Provenance tables and summary figure for the AIM6 catalytic-histidine analysis
code:
import os, json, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("cwd:",os.getcwd()); print(os.listdir(".")[:20])

# ---- assemble provenance tables from the numbers computed in previous cells ----
equiv=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(role="general base / proton acceptor (beta1)", GlpQ_P09394="His36", PI_PLC_1PTD="His32 (mature)",
      AIM6_Q07716="His120", evidence="structural equivalence (TM-align-like, <5 A) + 100% family conservation"),
 dict(role="divalent-metal ligand 1 (beta2)", GlpQ_P09394="Glu63", PI_PLC_1PTD="n/a (metal-independent)",
      AIM6_Q07716="Glu141", evidence="structural equivalence + 100% family conservation"),
 dict(role="divalent-metal ligand 2 (beta2)", GlpQ_P09394="Asp65", PI_PLC_1PTD="n/a",
      AIM6_Q07716="Asp143", evidence="structural equivalence + 100% family conservation"),
 dict(role="general acid / proton donor (beta3)", GlpQ_P09394="His78", PI_PLC_1PTD="His82 (mature)",
      AIM6_Q07716="His156", evidence="structural equivalence + 100% family conservation"),
 dict(role="divalent-metal ligand 3 (beta6)", GlpQ_P09394="Glu171", PI_PLC_1PTD="n/a",
      AIM6_Q07716="NOT conserved (Ile209 at the equivalent position; Asp210 nearby)",
      evidence="structural equivalence maps Glu171 to Ile209"),
 dict(role="substrate-binding Arg adjacent to base", GlpQ_P09394="Arg37", PI_PLC_1PTD="Arg69 (mature)",
      AIM6_Q07716="Asn121 (substituted)", evidence="sequence-adjacent position; Asn121 3.2 A from pocket centre"),
])
print("\n=== Catalytic residue equivalence table ===")
print(equiv.to_string(index=False))

metrics=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(comparison="AlphaFold AIM6 (Q07716) vs GlpQ 1YDY", TM_score=0.517, equivalences_lt5A=163, RMSD=2.88,
      catalytic_His_aligned="yes (His120<->His36, His156<->His78)"),
 dict(comparison="AlphaFold AIM6 vs B. cereus PI-PLC 1PTD", TM_score=0.270, equivalences_lt5A=50, RMSD=3.70,
      catalytic_His_aligned="no equivalence <5 A"),
 dict(comparison="GlpQ 1YDY vs PI-PLC 1PTD (positive control, same superfamily)", TM_score=0.322,
      equivalences_lt5A=np.nan, RMSD=np.nan, catalytic_His_aligned="no equivalence <5 A with this method"),
 dict(comparison="AIM6 vs triosephosphate isomerase 1TIM (unrelated TIM barrel, negative control)",
      TM_score=0.281, equivalences_lt5A=45, RMSD=np.nan, catalytic_His_aligned="n/a"),
])
print("\n=== Structural comparison metrics ===")
print(metrics.to_string(index=False))

geom=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(pair="catalytic His pair", AIM6_AlphaFold=7.22, GlpQ_1YDY=9.21, PI_PLC_1PTD=7.17),
 dict(pair="acidic pair E..D (metal site)", AIM6_AlphaFold=3.58, GlpQ_1YDY=3.44, PI_PLC_1PTD=np.nan),
 dict(pair="second acidic to proton-donor His", AIM6_AlphaFold=2.97, GlpQ_1YDY=6.18, PI_PLC_1PTD=np.nan),
 dict(pair="3-point anchor fit RMSD (His/Glu/His -> His36/Glu63/His78)", AIM6_AlphaFold=0.42,
      GlpQ_1YDY=0.0, PI_PLC_1PTD=np.nan),
])
print("\n=== Active-site geometry (A) ===")
print(geom.to_string(index=False))

for nm,d in [("aim6_catalytic_residue_equivalences",equiv),("aim6_structural_metrics",metrics),("aim6_active_site_geometry",geom)]:
    try:
        d.to_csv(f"{nm}.csv",index=False); print("wrote",os.path.abspath(nm+".csv"))
    except Exception as e: print("write fail",e)

# ---------- final provenance figure ----------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=0.45,wspace=0.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
tracks={"AIM6 Q07716":([118,120,122,141,143,156],["H","H","D","E","D","H"],115),
        "GlpQ P09394":([36,63,65,78],["H","E","D","H"],31),
        "PI-PLC P14262":([63,113],["H","H"],53)}
for i,(k,(ps,aa,o)) in enumerate(tracks.items()):
    y=3-i; xs=[p-o for p in ps]
    ax.plot([-2,max(xs)+8],[y,y],color="0.85",lw=4,zorder=0)
    for p,a,x in zip(ps,aa,xs):
        ax.scatter([x],[y],s=170,color={"H":"#1b6ca8","E":"#c0392b","D":"#e08214"}[a],zorder=3,edgecolor="w")
        ax.text(x,y+0.17,f"{a}{p}",ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
    ax.text(-6,y,k,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-60,70); ax.set_ylim(0.4,3.6); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residues from annotated catalytic-domain start")
ax.set_title("a  Conserved His/acidic spacing",loc="left",fontsize=11)
for s in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
lbl=["catalytic\nHis pair","metal pair\nGlu..Asp","Asp to\ndonor His"]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.27
ax.bar(x-w,[7.22,3.58,2.97],w,label="AIM6 AlphaFold",color="#1b6ca8")
ax.bar(x   ,[9.21,3.44,6.18],w,label="GlpQ 1YDY",color="#7fb3d5")
ax.bar(x+w,[7.17,np.nan,np.nan],w,label="PI-PLC 1PTD",color="#c0392b")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lbl,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylabel("min side-chain distance (A)")
ax.set_title("b  Active-site geometry",loc="left",fontsize=11); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
names=["AIM6 vs\nGlpQ","GlpQ vs\nPI-PLC","AIM6 vs\nPI-PLC","AIM6 vs\n1TIM"]
vals=[0.517,0.322,0.270,0.281]
cols=["#1b6ca8","0.6","0.75","0.85"]
ax.bar(names,vals,color=cols); ax.axhline(0.5,ls="--",color="k",lw=1)
ax.text(3.4,0.515,"TM 0.5 = same fold",ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("TM-score (ref-length normalised)"); ax.set_ylim(0,0.62)
ax.set_title("c  Structural similarity",loc="left",fontsize=11)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
pos=["H118","H120","D122","Y123","E141","D143","H156","Y160"]
val=[100,100,100,100,100,100,100,3]
ax.bar(pos,val,color=["#1b6ca8"]*7+["0.75"])
ax.set_ylabel("% identity in 30 orthologs"); ax.set_ylim(0,106)
ax.set_title("d  Conservation across the AIM6 family (IPR039559)\n20 fungi + 10 bacteria, 27-44% overall identity",loc="left",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1:])
ax.axis("off")
tbl=equiv[["role","GlpQ_P09394","PI_PLC_1PTD","AIM6_Q07716"]].copy()
tbl.columns=["role in GDPD/PI-PLC catalysis","GlpQ","B. cereus PI-PLC","AIM6"]
t=ax.table(cellText=tbl.values,colLabels=tbl.columns,loc="center",cellLoc="left")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.4); t.scale(1,1.55)
for (r,c),cell in t.get_celld().items():
    cell.set_linewidth(0.4)
    if r==0: cell.set_text_props(weight="bold"); cell.set_facecolor("#eef3f7")
ax.set_title("e  Residue equivalences from the seeded structural alignment",loc="left",fontsize=11)
plt.show()
